Market today: The mood is cautious, driven by the 10-year Treasury yield hitting its highest since 2002. This bond rout is a major headwind for growth stocks, especially your tech/chip heavy portfolio, as higher rates make future earnings less valuable.

Your holdings: SOXL (-34.21%) and SPAL (-31.89%) are flagged SELL, deeply in the red, and are leveraged ETFs. These are decaying assets, and rising yields amplify their risk, especially on margin.

Watch: Keep a close eye on bond yields; continued increases will pressure your tech/chip names. Also, monitor your leveraged ETFs for further decay and potential stop breaches.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management on your leveraged losers in this challenging rate environment.
plays: SOXL and SPAL are SELL status, leveraged, and down big. With yields rising, consider trimming or tightening stops to protect capital.
METU has an ACCUMULATE scanner setup (entry 30.59-30.56, stop 30.47). If adding to leveraged exposure, consider this entry but watch yields closely.
